Overview.Name: Suuda Gangi Reddy
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed for best results

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) (pan-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Curd rice (small bowl cooked rice & curd & salt)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (slightly higher portion) & chicken curry (pressure-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 2: Cooked rice (slightly higher portion) & fish curry (simple)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (pan-cooked)
Meal_3: Option 1: Egg curry (2 eggs) & small bowl cooked rice

Notes_and_Tips: Goal is healthy weight gain: increase portions slightly and prioritise protein at each meal.
Sweet cravings: use curd or fruit first; keep sweets only as a planned small portion.
Lose control once you start: serve a fixed plate and wait 10 minutes before taking more.
Irregular sleep: keep meal timings as consistent as possible to reduce cravings.
Bedtime (optional): warm turmeric milk (small cup, no sugar) or warm water.
SIMS / nutrition theory note: protein-first meals and steady timing improve satiety and stable energy.
